# شَقَقْتِ (šaqaqti) /ʃa.qaq.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of شَقَّ (šaqqa)
# شُقِقْتُ (šuqiqtu) /ʃu.qiq.tu/: first-person singular past passive of شَقَّ (šaqqa)
# شُقِقْتَ (šuqiqta) /ʃu
